tools.name: aqarsas_search_transactions
tools.description: Search registered Saudi real estate transactions by date, region, city, district, plan, unit, category, property type, price and area. The API returns up to 5,000 matching rows (a random 5,000 when more match); this tool returns the first `limit` of them. Each row has the date, category, property ki

tools.name: aqarsas_get_market_stats
tools.description: Aggregate Saudi real estate deal statistics: the number of deals, the total deal value, or the total area, broken down by category and property type, for a date range and a region, city or district. If hai is given, city is required. Aqarsas API: POST /stats/.

tools.name: aqarsas_get_top_transactions
tools.description: Rank Saudi real estate transactions by total deal price, price per m², or area, highest or lowest first, for a date range and a region, city or district. Date sorting is not offered here. Aqarsas API: POST /toptransactions/.

tools.name: aqarsas_get_property_details
tools.description: Look up a land plot or property and return up to 5 matching records, each with its full transaction history (up to 100 deals per record). Use rer_realestate_number when known; otherwise give state, city, m566 and unit, and area to rank close matches. Spatial fields (coordinates, elevation, zoning) a

tools.name: aqarsas_find_nearby_transactions
tools.description: Find recent deals on properties near a reference property, for comparable-sales analysis. The reference is identified by rer_realestate_number, or by state, city, m566 and unit (exactly one match is required). RER deal ids are masked by the API. Aqarsas API: POST /nearbytransactions/.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: aqarsas_search_transactions, aqarsas_get_market_stats, aqarsas_get_top_transactions, aqarsas_get_property_details · Private data: aqarsas_get_property_details · Public sink: aqarsas_search_transactions, aqarsas_get_market_stats, aqarsas_get_top_transactions, aqarsas_get_property_details, aqarsas_find_nearby_transactions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: aqarsas_search_transactions, aqarsas_get_market_stats, aqarsas_get_top_transactions, aqarsas_get_property_details · Private data: aqarsas_get_property_details · Public sink: aqarsas_search_transactions, aqarsas_get_market_stats, aqarsas_get_top_transactions, aqarsas_get_property_details, aqarsas_find_nearby_transactions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
